title: Use Reusable Water Bottles
preview: Switching to stainless or BPA-free reusable bottles reduces plastic waste.

title: Carry a Cloth Bag
preview: Using cloth bags instead of plastic bags decreases landfill pressure.

title: Reduce Electricity Usage
preview: Turn off lights and fans when not needed; it saves energy and money.

title: Compost Kitchen Waste

title: Walk for Short Distances
